title: Thai-Style Goats Cheese Pudding
description: A creamy and nutty Thai dessert made with goats cheese, nutty ingredients, and a touch of sweetness.
instructions: 2. In a blender, combine the softened goats cheese, ground almonds, cinnamon, and dissolved jel mixture. Blend until smooth.
3. Add the coconut milk and blend until well combined.
4. Pour the mixture into 4 ramekins or small cups.
5. Place the ramekins in a baking dish and add hot water to come halfway up the sides.
6. Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the pudding is set and slightly golden on top.
7. Remove the ramekins from the water bath and let cool to room temperature.
8. Serve chilled, garnished with toasted almonds or coconut flakes if desired.
